concepts.title: Educational universe

concepts.title: Inspectable scientific visual language

concepts.title: Temporal Geometry

concepts.limitations: A design chain is not a validated universal simulator.
concepts.next_step: Implement bounded history and test replay independence.

concepts.summary: Bounded atoms, molecular graphs and curated channels with sonification/export.
concepts.limitations: Hosting, listening tests and full scientific review incomplete.

concepts.title: Music creation field guide

concepts.title: Community martial arts center
concepts.summary: Shared training, learning, respectful etiquette and gathering across disciplines.
concepts.limitations: No venue, business demand or safe operating model verified.
concepts.next_step: Test one appropriately supervised community activity.

concepts.title: Virtual martial arts sandbox
concepts.summary: Playful first/third-person training world inspired by the community gym.
concepts.limitations: No confirmed playable build; game performance is not combat competence.

concepts.title: Philosopher Trainer VR
concepts.summary: Stylized mentors, movement and reflection across distinct headset targets.
concepts.limitations: Bootstrap prompts only; no hardware acceptance.
concepts.next_step: Choose one target and test safe tracking/pause behavior.

concepts.title: Shared cooperation missions
concepts.summary: Repair, escort, restore and welcome with peaceful participation.
concepts.limitations: Preserved offline authoring/reference kit with 25 freshly passing tests, not a playable game, Unity integration or rescue qualification. Source remains draft/unmerged.
concepts.next_step: Adapt one included mission in a bounded prototype while preserving its license, optional participation, and separate runtime/safety review requirements.

concepts.title: Sanctuary restoration world
concepts.summary: Rebuild hope, animal care, knowledge and infrastructure through cooperative play.
concepts.limitations: No confirmed title/build; audience and mature content need an explicit decision.
concepts.next_step: Prototype a single non-graphic restoration loop.

concepts.title: PHYSIO-MESH
concepts.summary: Low-burden sensing research with measured/proxy/inferred distinctions.
concepts.limitations: R&D scaffold, no validated device or clinical efficacy; no autonomous dosing.
concepts.next_step: Review claims and uncertainty architecture with qualified experts.

concepts.title: Accessible medical-science learning
concepts.summary: Motor-neuron-to-muscle exhibit and transparent health-evidence curriculum.
concepts.limitations: Curriculum foundation, not implemented runtime or clinical system.
concepts.next_step: Create one professionally reviewed non-diagnostic lesson.

concepts.title: Music of Matter speculative dialogue
concepts.summary: Interdisciplinary-care aspiration explored through speculative characters.
concepts.limitations: Invented successes are not a cure, study or protocol.
concepts.next_step: Extract questions only and label fiction explicitly.

concepts.title: No One Holds the Sky Alone
concepts.summary: Connection that preserves individuality and distributes the burden of care.

concepts.title: Universal Trail
